features.note: Generated signage exists where visible: corridor shows numbered auditorium plates (2,1,6,5 legible), generated abstract poster panels, chevron carpet pattern, and a red 'Cinemex' marquee wordmark on the facade. No protected movie art anywhere. But four of the seven required architecture captures (facade, lobby, concessions, kitchen) do not show the surfaces they are supposed to prove: lobby and concessions are filled by the exterior roof slab, kitchen is a near-blank gray ceiling plane, and facade renders the building as a thin distant band. Evacuation/exit markings are not evidenced in any capture. The plan grammar is therefore reinforced by surface only in corridor and sala-3.

sala-3 delivers all three surface items: a rhythm of dark/red acoustic panel strips along both side walls, yellow aisle marking lines on the dark carpet, and an abstract red/yellow generated screen graphic that is unambiguously not protected imagery. Frame0 vs frame1 differ (106,860 px) so the screen content is deterministic and changes. Held back by bright white auditorium side walls that read as generic drywall rather than absorptive surface, and by a screen slab that is small for the room.

The generated menu boards do exist (three boards reading SNACKS / DRINKS / FRESH with abstract line-item bars) but are only visible in the engineering capture, where they render as oversized black slabs floating above and clear of any counter, crossing the facade glass line. In the architecture concessions and lobby captures the entire front-of-house is hidden behind the roof slab. The facade digital poster bank renders as four flat, empty dark-maroon panels with no generated poster graphic, and the facade view changes by only 541 px between poster_frame 0 and 1 (~0.008% of the frame) — the two-frame poster proof effectively does not land at the facade. No POS faces, snack-machine cues or wayfinding graphics are visible in any capture.

The diagram board reads left-to-right and carries most of the chain: BUS A/B/C/D boxes naming TC01-TC14, green arrowheaded 'RS-485 / MODBUS RTU' edges into UC100-A/B/C/D, blue dashed LoRaWAN RF into UG67-01, blue solid Ethernet down to ROUTER/FIREWALL. It IS linked to the model, not replacing it: a cyan leader runs from the board's 'UG67-01 · UBICACIÓN REAL / VÍNCULO AL MODELO' pill to a marker on the real UG67, and the eng-ug67 capture shows a real two-antenna UG67 with green trunks, dashed links and UC-B/UC-C/UC-D labels. But the chain does NOT read end-to-end unambiguously. (1) The INTERNET -> NIAGARA SUPERVISOR edge has no drawn connector and no arrowhead: the two boxes abut and the 'NIAGARA SUPERVISOR' caption overflows its box leftward across the INTERNET box, so the single most important upstream hop is a text collision, not an edge. (2) NIAGARA -> PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE lines carry no arrowheads, so client direction is asserted only by layout. (3) The 'VÍNCULO AL MODELO' pill sits on top of the UG67's fourth RF port, occluding it and its incoming UC100-D arrowhead; the ports are labelled RF1/RF2/RF3 only — three labels for four links. (4) 'ROUTER / FIREWALL' and 'SMARTPHONE' captions also overflow their pills. (5) In eng-complete-network, the preset whose job is to expose the whole chain, none of the in-model media is legible: no green trunks, no dashed LoRaWAN, no blue Ethernet; the external schematic renders as six unlabeled floating colored slabs with no connecting lines at all. The physical chain is invisible at its own preset and the board silently carries it.

The two states are visually distinct and the engineering state does what it promises: shell drops to translucency, devices/labels/zones/links appear, and the board legend (RS-485 solid green / LoRaWAN dashed / Ethernet solid blue / Alarma red / Sin comunicación gray) is legible. But labels are not suppressed in the architecture state: surface-attempt1-arch-frame0-kitchen shows TC05, UC-D and BUS D technical label pills floating over an otherwise blank gray plane, which is both a state leak and the only content in that frame. The engineering captures are also heavily washed: translucent shell, pink seat bleed-through and thick pale-blue tubes overlap the thin green/blue network media so the media cannot be traced.

important_features.note: 1.8 m people, door heights, small TC300/UC100 and a correctly small UG67 with two vertical antennas all read at correct relative scale in corridor and ug67 views. Undercut by the concession menu boards, which render several metres wide and float free of any counter.
Owned by the lighting-camera pass; not scored down here. Neutral flat lighting is present and does not obscure surface content in the corridor or sala-3.

Green RS-485 trunks and drops do route along walls/ceiling and terminate on device bodies in the ug67 view. But the external IP schematic objects (router, cloud, Niagara, PC, tablet, phone) hang in space as unconnected colored slabs with no Ethernet line linking them, and no label; the Ethernet run leaves the UG67 and visually dead-ends.

corrections: Draw an explicit arrowed edge from the INTERNET box to the NIAGARA SUPERVISOR box on the diagram board, with the same blue solid Ethernet style and a visible arrowhead. Increase the horizontal gap between the ETHERNET row boxes so no edge is shorter than its own arrowhead.
Fit every diagram-board caption inside its box: shrink the font or widen the box for 'NIAGARA SUPERVISOR', 'ROUTER / FIREWALL' and 'SMARTPHONE' so no text overprints an adjacent node.
Add arrowheads to the four LoRaWAN dashed edges (UC100 -> UG67) and to the three Niagara -> PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE edges so every edge in the chain states its direction.

Move the 'UG67-01 · UBICACIÓN REAL / VÍNCULO AL MODELO' pill out of the UG67 node body — place it below or beside the node — and label all four RF ports RF1..RF4 so four links land on four labelled ports.

Make the in-model network legible at the complete-network preset: raise the RS-485 trunk, LoRaWAN and Ethernet line widths (or use screen-space-constant width), and lift their distance-cull threshold so green trunks, blue dashed links and the blue Ethernet run are visible at that camera distance.

Connect and label the external schematic objects in the model: draw the blue solid Ethernet run UG67 -> router -> internet -> Niagara -> clients between the six blocks, and attach ID labels (ROUTER/FIREWALL, INTERNET, NIAGARA, PC, TABLET, SMARTPHONE) so they are not anonymous floating slabs.

Reframe or unocclude the lobby, concessions and kitchen architecture presets so they show their fit-out: hide the public roof (or clip the near roof plane) for these presets, and move the lobby/concessions cameras inside the front public band instead of outside the facade at z>22.5.
Suppress technical device labels (TC05, UC-D, BUS D and peers) in state=architecture; restrict them to state=engineering or an explicit labels=on request.

Give the facade digital poster bank real generated content: draw distinct abstract poster graphics onto each of the four panels via CanvasTexture, and make them visibly change between poster_frame 0 and 1 so the facade capture pair carries the determinism proof instead of a 541 px delta.

Anchor the concession menu boards to the concession counter: reduce their size to a plausible 1.2-1.8 m board, mount them on the back wall above the service line, and stop them from intersecting the facade glass.

Add the missing front-of-house surface cues that the spec claims: POS faces on the counter, snack-machine graphics, and wayfinding/evacuation markings in the corridor, so the front-of-house and evacuation claims have pixels.
Darken the auditorium side-wall surface toward the charcoal acoustic value so the acoustic panel rhythm reads against it instead of against white drywall.

Reduce the engineering-state bleed-through: lower the seat/zone transparency contribution and increase the emissive contrast of the RS-485 green and LoRaWAN blue media so a single TC300 -> UC100 -> UG67 route can be traced by eye in the engineering captures.
